name: Boeing
verdict: A US court found that Boeing's deception of regulators led to the 737 MAX crashes that killed 346 people.
note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): The Boeing Company (listed; largest holders Vanguard 9.0%, FMR 7.0%, BlackRock 6.8%) - Boeing admitted in 2021 that its pilots deceived the FAA about the 737 MAX, and a US federal judge found in 2022 that without that conspiracy the 346 people killed in two crashes would not have died.

why.text: In 2021 Boeing admitted that two of its pilots had deceived US regulators about the 737 MAX's MCAS flight-control system. In 2022 a US federal judge found that, but for Boeing's conspiracy to defraud the regulator, the 346 people killed in two 737 MAX crashes would not have lost their lives.
why.messageLine: A US federal judge found that, but for Boeing's conspiracy to defraud the FAA, 346 people would not have lost their lives in the two 737 MAX crashes.
